## Findings from Today's Research

### Orca decision 1 live (#3704)
The fleet's hook-state-stale bug on first Orca run is fixed. Decision 1 from doc 2581 is now built: hooks now read from `orca worktree ps --json` rather than the stale pane. First live run confirmed.

### 10% efficiency measurement (doc 2584)
Three independent instruments (state transitions, transcript buckets, fleet-health snapshots) all agree: the fleet worked ~1 hour in every 10 it was open on Oct 1. Waiting is not wasted compute — most lanes had nothing queued. Two improvements adopted *after* 4 Oct:
- KD3: A lane that stamps HANDOFF-READY with no queued step closes its pane itself
- KD4: Seat wakes lanes by envelope only when there's an unblocked step — no "are you there" pings
